corpus_results.citation: 4,4'-Diaminodiphenyl sulfone (DDS), CAS 80-08-0, formula C12H12N2O2S, MW 248.30. Cited as the hot-curing aromatic-amine reference hardener in Wiegand & Osburg (2023), 'Synthesis, Curing and Thermal Behavior of Amine Hardeners from Potentially Renewable Sources', Polymers 15(4):990, https://doi.org/10.3390/polym15040990 (CC BY 4.0; fetched and license text confirmed verbatim from https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9962791/ in the prior W-D-ROLE sweep fire, source 9).
corpus_results.note: real external molecule, canonical SMILES verified disjoint from all 41 canonical SMILES in reference/phase0-role-known-answer.v2.json (44 records). Both amines are aniline-type (exocyclic NH2 on an aromatic ring, not an in-ring pyrrole/imidazole N-H like EMI-24's hostile null), neither adjacent to the ring's own carbonyl/sulfonyl carbon (the sulfone S is two bonds from each N, not a direct neighbor), so both should count as reactive amine H.

corpus_results.citation: 4-Amino-3-methoxybenzylamine ('Compound 5' in the source paper), synthesized from vanillin, formula C8H12N2O, MW 152.2 (matches the paper's reported M+=152). Wiegand & Osburg (2023), Polymers 15(4):990, https://doi.org/10.3390/polym15040990 (CC BY 4.0). Paper states: 'Two differently substituted diamines were prepared to act as amine-curing agents for epoxy resins' and reports DSC onset 71C / Tg 68C, cold-curing behavior similar to IPDA -- an independent published DSC/TGA cure-behavior attestation of hardener role, not a supplier TDS claim.
corpus_results.note: novel bio-based/renewable amine hardener chemotype (lignin-derived), zero representation in the 44-record self-authored fixture per the prior sweep's structural_or_factor_overlap finding. One aromatic (aniline-type) NH2 plus one aliphatic benzylic CH2NH2, neither carbonyl/sulfonyl-adjacent.

corpus_results.citation: 4-Amino-3,5-dimethoxybenzylamine ('Compound 6' in the source paper), synthesized from syringaldehyde, formula C9H14N2O2, MW 182.22 (matches the paper's reported M+=182). Same source and license as compound 5. Paper reports DSC onset 79C / Tg 160C and TGA thermal stability 'similar to those formed with IPDA'.
corpus_results.note: second independent instance of the lignin-derived bio-based amine hardener chemotype, dimethoxy-substituted analog of compound 5.

corpus_results.citation: Discrete n=5 oligomer analog of a poly(propylene glycol) diamine polyetheramine (Jeffamine/Baxxodur-class; BASF's own Baxxodur EC-1xx/2xx/3xx product-line description states 'EC 302 = polyetheramine D 400 analog', fetched verbatim from basf.com/global/en/legal.html + product pages in the prior W-D-ROLE sweep fire, source 4). Commercial Jeffamine/Baxxodur polyetheramine products are average-MW mixtures over a distribution of n; this harness uses a single discrete n=5 oligomer (MW 364.5) as a structural representative, matching how the portfolio's own DGEBA oligomer-series receipts already handle polymeric analogs with an explicit n.
corpus_results.note: polyetheramine chemotype, zero representation in the 44-record fixture per the prior sweep's structural_or_factor_overlap finding. Two terminal primary amines on secondary carbons, polyether backbone, no carbonyl/sulfonyl neighbor to either amine nitrogen.

corpus_results.citation: Simplified single-Mannich-site phenalkamine: cardanol (a C15-alkyl-substituted phenol from cashew nutshell liquid, CNSL) condensed with formaldehyde and triethylenetetramine (TETA) via the Mannich reaction, the synthesis route documented for Cardolite NX-series phenalkamine curing agents (cardolite.com/phenalkamines/, prior W-D-ROLE sweep fire source 5) and in the open cure-chemistry literature (e.g. Jaillet et al. and related cardanol-Mannich-base curing-kinetics studies of phenalkamines synthesized from polyethylenepolyamines). Uses a saturated C15 alkyl chain in place of real cardanol's mixed mono/di/tri-ene chain (41% triene major component) -- immaterial to the has_oxirane/reactive_amine_hydrogen rule under test, which does not inspect the alkyl tail.
corpus_results.note: phenalkamine chemotype, zero representation in the 44-record fixture per the prior sweep's structural_or_factor_overlap finding -- flagged there as directly analogous in kind to the guanidine gap that broke the rule once already (a whole chemotype family absent from the self-authored fixture). Three secondary benzylamine/polyamine N-H (1H each) plus one terminal primary N-H2 (2H) = 5 reactive amine H expected; none adjacent to a carbonyl/sulfonyl carbon or sulfur. Phenalkamines are formulated as the stoichiometric hardener component in industry TDS/literature (unlike DPG/ DOTG guanidine accelerators, which are never listed as curing agents and are used at sub-stoichiometric catalytic loadings), so 'hardener' is the correct attested expectation, not a repeat of the guanidine failure mode.

corpus_results.citation: 3,4-Epoxycyclohexylmethyl 3,4-epoxycyclohexanecarboxylate (ERL-4221 / Uvacure-1500-class cycloaliphatic epoxy cross-linker), CAS 2386-87-0, formula C14H20O4, MW 252.31. PubChem / Sigma-Aldrich product 407208 / Cymit Quimica CAS record (cymitquimica.com/cas/2386-87-0), cross-checked 2026-08-16. Real, widely-used non-glycidyl cycloaliphatic diepoxy resin (UV-stable marine/aerospace topcoats), zero representation in the 39-record self-authored fixture (which is exclusively glycidyl-ether DGEBA-family resins) and never probed by any prior role-ranker fire.
corpus_results.note: Hardest oxirane-side structural test the module has faced: two FUSED bicyclo[4.1.0]heptane epoxide rings (SSSR perception for fused/bridged polycyclics is a documented cheminformatics edge case) exercised across the full canonical/kekule/every-atom-rooted/explicit-H sweep.
